arithmetic.contiguous_probability_reduction: NumPy 2.3.5 small-array eight-accumulator reduction with fixed final grouping and scalar tail; posterior mass normalization has 33 entries and teacher positive-event compression has 16 entries
arithmetic.matrix_neural_and_encoder_bank_reduction: explicit separate products and left-to-right accumulation; unchanged by contiguous probability reduction
arithmetic.scalar: rounded binary64; separate products; reduction order specified for each path
arithmetic.transcendentals: platform tanh and exp; integrated binary must be independently qualified; no portable bitwise guarantee

bank.prediction: no new observation; actual scheduled future drives and durations
bank.reduction: coordinate-ordered left-to-right event mass accumulation, matching the encoder mask-product path

checkpoint.law: supplied transition tables; generators and physical metadata are not reexecuted

observation.decoder: binary sign noise at reliability[observation_tick-1], then checkpoint 2x2 confusion matrix
observation.failure: public failure probability independent of latent state; zero-probability trace outcomes rejected
observation.repair: repairs sensor only; latent distribution is not reset; repair fee and elapsed-step latency are charged
observation.time: actual due boundary, never request time

representation.analytic_endpoint_belief: existing output field equals bank[7] exactly; encoder diagnostic with its declared bank reduction
representation.hidden: 48 tanh units followed by exact +1 bias
representation.readout: first three affine rows are WAIT, READ, REPAIR; sigmoid of fourth affine row is learned belief
representation.state: actual causal trace, including actual path charges; never replaced by the teacher representative

state.prior: equal mass at nearest interior coordinates to plus/minus prior_distance; allowed distances 0.125, 0.375, 0.75

target.partition: strict >; X=0 belongs to the nonpositive event

teacher.belief: analytic supplied-law endpoint posterior; positive coordinate masses are boolean-compressed in coordinate order and summed using the pinned contiguous reduction; internal Bellman value, not a replacement for the analytic_endpoint_belief output field
teacher.branches: zero probabilities skipped; no probability renormalization
teacher.compiled_row_state: first full state reached by LIFO DFS for each Markov key; reused for every trace with that key
teacher.representative_traversal: start at initial; pop last; skip seen Markov keys; push legal WAIT, READ, REPAIR in increasing action order; for a due request push failure, observation 0, observation 1 in that order; structural support includes zero-probability outcomes
teacher.selection: first legal maximum in fixed action order; illegal scores are zero with separate mask
teacher.source_scope: pinned planning.enumerate_states(full_state=False) and compile_own representative selection; ordinary binary64, not portable bitwise equality or source authentication
teacher.sunk_charges: encoder retains actual path charges; compiled-row Q retains first representative charge bits for rounded successor-charge subtraction; recursive future Bellman value uses zero sunk charges as in the pinned Oracle
teacher.utility: risk-neutral additive expected terminal reward minus future read, repair and latency charges
